title: Sign-in page
summary: The sign-in page of an app: e-mail and password, Google, account creation by invitation, the one-use first-owner link.
purpose: The registry block's SignInPage alone over a fake Worker, in Coach Max's theme (lime primary on paper, light and dark), in French and English. A person opens it for the first time, switches between sign-in and account creation, signs in with a wrong password and then the right one; opened from the first-owner link it waits for the Worker, then shows the owner's sign-up for a good link and a refusal above the ordinary form for a used or unknown one.
notes: On a phone every full-width button of the block (the main one, « Continuer avec Google ») is at least 48 px high, where the rest of the kit keeps 44. The two switch links are drawn in the text colour, underlined, with at least 4.5:1 on the page in both themes (the theme's primary is a light lime). A wrong password is read under the form and the main button keeps its place and size while « Un instant… » shows. Opened from the first-owner link the page shows a neutral wait until the Worker answers (it answers 2 s late on purpose in the `late-` flows) and never shows « Vous installez » or the owner's sign-up before a good answer: the fixture checks that after every change of the page, not only at frames.
